SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.course_no AS courseNo, c.credit, c.hours, c.semester, s.teacher_id AS teacherId, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, false AS evaluated FROM course_selection cs INNER JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN schedule s ON s.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN teacher t ON s.teacher_id = t.id
cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teaching_evaluation te WHERE te.student_id = cs.student_id AND te.course_id = cs.course_id )
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.course_no, c.credit, c.hours, c.semester, s.teacher_id, t.teacher_name ORDER BY c.semester DESC, c.name ASC

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.course_no AS courseNo, c.credit, c.hours, c.semester, t.id AS teacherId, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, true AS evaluated, te.attitude_score AS attitudeScore, te.content_score AS contentScore, te.method_score AS methodScore, te.effect_score AS effectScore, ROUND((te.attitude_score + te.content_score + te.method_score + te.effect_score) / 4.0, 1) AS overallScore, DATE_FORMAT(te.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS evaluateTime, te.comment FROM teaching_evaluation te INNER JOIN course c ON te.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN teacher t ON te.teacher_id = t.id WHERE te.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY te.create_time DESC

SELECT t.id AS teacherId, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, COUNT(te.id) AS totalEvaluations, ROUND(AVG(te.attitude_score), 1) AS avgAttitudeScore, ROUND(AVG(te.content_score), 1) AS avgContentScore, ROUND(AVG(te.method_score), 1) AS avgMethodScore, ROUND(AVG(te.effect_score), 1) AS avgEffectScore, ROUND((AVG(te.attitude_score) + AVG(te.content_score) + AVG(te.method_score) + AVG(te.effect_score)) / 4.0, 1) AS avgOverallScore FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN teaching_evaluation te ON te.teacher_id = t.id WHERE t.id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY t.id, t.teacher_name
